descriptions.zh: 一艘巨大的方舟战舰在战斗中被摧毁，留下了一片广阔的残骸。其基础设施、引擎和船体的残余可能为打捞提供有价值的材料。
descriptions.en: A colossal arkship has been destroyed in battle, leaving behind a vast field of wreckage. The remains of its infrastructure, engines, and hull may yield valuable materials for salvage.

descriptions.zh: 我们的一艘方舟舰陷入黑暗无助漂流，它的各个系统都被紧急关闭了。只要派遣到位，我们的工程师就可以恢复供电，重新取得控制，使其恢复正常运作。
descriptions.en: One of our Arkships lies dark and adrift, its systems forced into emergency shutdown. Once brought alongside, our engineering crews can restore power, reassert control, and bring it back into the fold.

descriptions.zh: 我们的一座驿站陷入了黑暗，它的各个系统都被紧急关闭了。只要派遣到位，我们的工程师就可以恢复供电，重新取得控制，使其恢复正常运作。
descriptions.en: One of our Waystations has gone dark, its systems forced into emergency shutdown. Once brought alongside, our engineering crews can restore power, reassert control, and bring it back into the fold.

descriptions.zh: 冠铸秀已为前往赛场准备了专用虫洞。请在截止日期前将您的舰队送达指定地点，准备铸就属于您的传奇！
descriptions.en: The CFL has prepared a specialized wormhole to the competition grounds. Deliver your fleet to the designated location before the deadline and prepare to forge your legacy!

sections.zh: 准入要求：一支具有至多§H[event_target:champions_forge_enclave_country.GetCFLFleetSizeRequirement]舰队规模§!的舰队。
sections.en: Entry requirement: a fleet of at most §H[event_target:champions_forge_enclave_country.GetCFLFleetSizeRequirement] Fleet Size§!.

descriptions.zh:
没有人能独自守护星系。

在采取行动之前，我们必须赢得我们希望保护之人的信任。这种信任始于诚实、克制和外交。

我们将培养新一代特使，通过言行证明我们在此是为了提供帮助。只有齐心协力，我们才能建立足以抵御未来挑战的强大联盟。
descriptions.en:
No one defends the galaxy alone.

Before we can act, we must earn the trust of those we hope to protect. That trust begins with honesty, restraint, and diplomacy.

We will train a new generation of envoys to prove through word and deed that we are here to help. Only together can we build alliances strong enough to weather what lies ahead.

descriptions.zh:
我们已经取得了信任。但我们必须培养信念。

既然星系与我们同在，我们必须给它的人民一些可以信仰的东西，一些即使在最黑暗的时刻也能经久不衰的象征。不仅仅是旗帜或口号，而是勇气、团结和坚不可摧的承诺的标志，我们将站在他们与风暴之间。

让每一个感性众生都看向这些象征，并记住：他们并不孤单。
descriptions.en:
Trust is earned. Faith must be nurtured.

Now that the galaxy stands with us, we must give its people something to believe in, symbols that can endure even the darkest hour. Not mere banners or slogans, but emblems of courage, unity, and the unshakable promise that we will stand between them and the storm.

Let every sentient being look to these symbols and remember: they are not alone.

descriptions.zh:
星系中存在的威胁不容忽视。我们不能坐等黑暗降临。我们将谨慎而小心地展开一系列高风险行动，以揭示前方潜藏的危险。

§R这将触发终末危机§!
descriptions.en:
The galaxy holds threats too great to ignore. We cannot afford to wait for the darkness to reveal itself. With caution and care, we will begin a series of high-risk operations to uncover what dangers lie ahead.

§RThis will trigger the End Game Crisis§!

descriptions.zh:
我们前期所作的大量工作已被证明是必要的，尽管我们也取得了成功，但这并不是终点。

星系浩瀚无垠，危机四伏。我们必须继续搜寻，确保没有威胁能逃过我们的监视。

这些实验是危险的，但如果邪恶仍然潜伏在黑暗中，我们别无选择，只能面对它。

§R这将触发第二次终末危机§!
descriptions.en:
Our early efforts have proven necessary, and though successful, they are not the end.

The galaxy is vast and full of danger. We must continue our search to ensure that no threat escapes our watch.

These experiments are perilous, but if evil still lurks in the dark, we have no choice but to face it.

§RThis will trigger a second End Game Crisis§!

descriptions.zh: 艺术与科技相结合，创造出在黑暗中熠熠生辉的自由象征。
descriptions.en: Art meets technology to create symbols of freedom that will shine bright against the darkness.

descriptions.zh: 我们必须在该星系部署一颗间谍卫星，以履行我们的合约。
descriptions.en: We must deploy a Spy Satellite in this system to fulfill our contract.

descriptions.zh: 我们被委派走私关键任务物资，以支援间谍网络。
descriptions.en: We have been tasked with smuggling critical mission supplies to support the Spy Network.

descriptions.zh: 我们需要协助潜入该星系的一个恒星基地。
descriptions.en: Our assistance is required to infiltrate a Starbase in this system.

descriptions.zh:
坐标指向了一艘巨大飞船的残骸，其上层结构与标准的方舟舰设计相符。

初步探测结果表明发生了灾难性的内部故障。全面调查可能会发现与§Y塞拉伦涅§!恢复的记忆相关的线索。
descriptions.en:
The coordinates led to the remains of a massive vessel, its superstructure consistent with standard Arkship design.

Preliminary readings suggest catastrophic internal failure. A full investigation may uncover traces linked to §YSeralune§!'s recovered memories.

sections.zh: 轨道上有$COUNT$/$REQUIRED$艘方舟或科研船。
sections.en: Has $COUNT$/$REQUIRED$ Arkship or Science Ship in orbit.

descriptions.zh: 重建破碎的飞船并非易事，但这样做或许能揭示§Y塞拉伦涅§!的起源，以及她注定要继承的遗产。
descriptions.en: Rebuilding the shattered vessel will be difficult, but doing so may reveal the origins of §YSeralune§! and the legacy she was meant to inherit.

descriptions.zh:
祖传文献记载，在此坐标发生了一件至关重要的事情。他们称之为“显化之地”，据说这里是他们启动仪式以祈求神灵降临的地方。据说那是一个奇迹之地。初步扫描显示存在大幅磁偏转。

岁月流逝，此处已面目全非，但我们仍应前往调查，以探究显化之地所蕴含的精神意义。
descriptions.en:
The ancestral writings describe a crucial event that occurred at these coordinates. Known to them as Emergence, this was where they initiated a ritual to invoke the deities. It was said to be a place of wonder. Initial scans indicate substantial magnetic deviation.

Time has rendered it much changed, but we should investigate regardless, for Emergence's spiritual significance.

descriptions.zh: 用我们祖先的话来说，在§Y[this.GetName]§!的国境范围内有一只“不眠之眼”。我们理解这应该是指一座轨道天文台。
descriptions.en: In the words of our ancestors, there is an 'Unsleeping Eye' within §Y[this.GetName]§!'s grasp. We understand this to be a reference to an orbital observatory.

descriptions.zh: 根据我们的圣典记载，§Y[this.GetName]§!曾是一座古老修道院的所在地。
descriptions.en: According to our sacred texts, §Y[this.GetName]§! was once the location of an ancient monastery.

descriptions.zh: 我们的祖先高度重视§Y[this.GetName]§!。如果我们正确理解了这些文本，一些非常重要的事情正在这里等待着我们。
descriptions.en: Our ancestors held §Y[this.GetName]§! in high regard. If we have understood the texts correctly, something very important awaits us here.

descriptions.zh:
我们检测到源自这些坐标的人工信号。奇怪的是，这里据说是我们其中一个神圣遗址。信号包含一段编码信息，我们已将其转录并翻译成语言。

“§Y崇拜已启用。和平现在可以开始。§!”
descriptions.en:
We have detected an artificial signal originating from these coordinates. Curiously, this is where one of our Sacred Sites is purported to be. The signal contains a coded message which we have transcribed and translated to language.

"§YWORSHIP IS ENABLED. PEACE MAY NOW COMMENCE.§!"

descriptions.zh: 据先祖们的记载，§Y[this.GetName]§!有一颗天然卫星，是追随我们信仰的长者们最终安息之所。
descriptions.en: According to the Ancestors' logs, §Y[this.GetName]§! has a natural satellite which serves as a final resting place for elders of our faith.

descriptions.zh: §Y[this.GetName]§!曾令我们的祖先感到恐惧。他们的传说中提到“潜伏在地表以下深坑中”的“危险而强大的野兽”。
descriptions.en: §Y[this.GetName]§! was feared by our progenitors. Their legends speak of a "dangerous and powerful beast" that "lurks in a pit below the surface".

descriptions.zh:
此地有一处神圣遗址，其名根据我们祖先的语言大致翻译为§Y镜子§!。

据说此地天界之间的界限异常稀薄，人们可能会遭遇来自我们宇宙之外的异界生物。
descriptions.en:
There is a Sacred Site at this location, its name roughly translated from our ancestral language as the §YMirror§!.

It is said that the boundary between celestial planes is thinner here, and one may confront other-worldly entities from beyond our universe.

descriptions.zh: 以太巨龙的鳞片散发出一种明显的能量，必须极其谨慎地对待。任何试图开展的采集行动都应小心进行，因为此类生物的残骸可能仍带有不可预知的特性。
descriptions.en: The Ether Drake scales radiate a palpable power that warrants extreme caution. Any attempt to collect them should proceed carefully, as the remnants of such a creature may still carry unpredictable properties.

descriptions.zh:
方舟舰的§H轴基挂载武器§!安装工作已导致舰船前部体产生危险的结构应力。

我们将派遣一艘§H后勤船§!，全面加固受影响的区域。
descriptions.en:
The installation of the Arkship's §HSpinal Mount§! has introduced dangerous structural stresses along the vessel's forward hull.

A §HLogistics Ship§! will be dispatched to fully reinforce the affected sections.

descriptions.zh: 影响方舟舰上人群的记忆迷雾将持续存在，直到我们绘制出§Y[event_target:memory_fog_location.GetName]§!的共振剖面为止。
descriptions.en: The memory fog affecting the Arkship's population will persist until we map the resonance profile of §Y[event_target:memory_fog_location.GetName]§!.

descriptions.zh: 蔓延于§Y方舟舰[Root.GetName]§!水培舱室的入侵真菌物种已迅速适应了飞船的受控生态系统。若不加干预，其密集的菌丝网络恐将导致粮食产量大幅下降。
descriptions.en: The invasive fungal species spreading through the hydroponics decks of §YArkship [Root.GetName]§! has rapidly adapted to the ship's controlled ecosystem. Left unchecked, its dense mycelial networks threaten to significantly reduce food production.

descriptions.zh: 我们将尝试与遍布§Y方舟舰[Root.GetName]§!水培舱的入侵真菌物种进行沟通。如果不加以控制，其密集的菌丝网络将造成严重威胁并降低粮食产量。
descriptions.en: We will attempt to communicate with the invasive fungal species spreading through the hydroponics decks of §YArkship [Root.GetName]§!. If left unchecked, its dense mycelial networks threaten to significantly reduce food production.

descriptions.zh: 方舟舰§Y[Root.GetName]§!的船员们长时间以来行为异常。报告显示他们的日常活动变得反复无常，其中几名船员表现出对某种事物迷恋，并且什么事情都藏着掖着的迹象。建议进行调查。
descriptions.en: The crew members of Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§! have been acting abnormally for an extended period. Reports suggest their routines have become erratic, with several crew members displaying signs of infatuation and secrecy. Investigation is recommended.

descriptions.zh: 我们需要调查资源到哪里去了。
descriptions.en: We need to explore where our resources keep disappearing to.

descriptions.zh: 我们必须仔细扫描该物体，以确定其来源以及内部是否有任何东西在漫长的虚空漂流中幸存下来。
descriptions.en: We must carefully scan the object to determine its origin and whether anything inside has survived the long drift through the void.

sections.zh: 轨道上有$COUNT$/$REQUIRED$艘方舟或者科研船。
sections.en: Has $COUNT$/$REQUIRED$ Arkship(s) or Science Ship(s) in orbit.

descriptions.zh: 我们必须飞到指定恒星系并扫描逃生舱，以确定其乘员是否还活着。
descriptions.en: We must fly to the indicated system and scan the pod to determine whether its occupant still lives.

sections.zh: 轨道上有$COUNT$/$REQUIRED$艘方舟或者科研船。
sections.en: Has $COUNT$/$REQUIRED$ Arkship(s) or Science Ship(s) in orbit.
